verses.text: Can't you hear Wisdom calling? Understanding is raising her voice!
She stands up high beside the road, right where the paths cross.
Next to the gates, at the doors where people enter the city, she calls out,
“Hey, people, I'm calling you! I want every human being to hear me.
If you're easily led, learn some good judgment! If you've been acting a fool, get some sense in your heart!
Listen up. I've got excellent things to say, and what comes out of my mouth is right.
I speak the truth. The thought of saying something wicked disgusts me.
Everything I say is fair and right. There's nothing twisted or shady in my words.
People with understanding can see that my words are clear. People who have found knowledge know my words are right.
Take my teaching over silver. Pick knowledge over the finest gold.
Wisdom beats rubies. Nothing you could want even comes close.
“I, Wisdom, live with good judgment. Go find knowledge and learn to think before you act.
To stand in awe of the LORD is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, crooked talk, and the road that leads to evil.
I've got good advice and solid knowledge. Understanding and strength belong to me.
Through me kings reign and rulers make fair laws.
Through me rulers govern, along with nobles and everyone on earth who rules justly.
I love the people who love me. Anyone who seriously looks for me will find me.
I've got riches and honor, wealth that lasts, and prosperity.
What I grow is worth more than gold, even pure gold. My harvest is worth more than the finest silver.
I walk the road of doing right, right down the middle of the paths of justice,
so I can give wealth to the people who love me and fill up their treasuries.
“The LORD had me at the start of his work, before he did any of those things long ago.
I was set in place from eternity, right at the beginning, before the earth was even there.
I was born before the deep waters were there, before there were springs pouring out water.
Before the mountains got set in place, before the hills, I was born.
He hadn't made the earth or the fields yet, or even the first dust in the world.
When he set the heavens in place, I was right there. I saw him draw a circle across the face of the deep,
set the clouds up above and make the springs of the deep surge with strength.
I was there when he set a limit for the sea so its waters couldn't cross the line he gave them, and when he marked out the earth's foundations.
I was the craftworker right beside him. Day after day I was a delight, always celebrating in front of him,
celebrating in the whole world he made and taking joy in the people there.
“So now, my sons, hear me out. People who stick to my ways are blessed.
Listen when you're taught, and get wise. Don't push the lesson away.
Blessed is anyone who listens to me, who keeps watch at my gates day after day and waits by my doorway.
Whoever finds me finds life and receives favor from the LORD.
Whoever sins against me hurts their own soul. Everyone who hates me is in love with death.”
